notes.text: The Rude Hero comes equipped with [_LEATHER GLOVES_], a [_COTTON SHIRT_], and the [_DEATH EMPEROR_] soul by default, as well as the [_TALISMAN_] valuable.

Shadow Hearts' battle system is very unique, actually requiring a little bit of skill. Press the CROSS button within the highlighted areas on the Judgment Ring for successful attacks. Once you get used to the system more, feel free to try to time your attacks just right to succeed in more critical attacks in the smaller red area. If you miss though, you miss an attack completely.
It's impossible to win this battle, so feel free to just wail away at him, practicing your Judgment Ring until he uses Revelation to end the battle.

After watching the greatest intro of video game history, head down to the next
train car. Go just a little bit further to enter into your first battle with a
couple of Wind Shears.

  NOTE     Shadow Hearts' battle system is very unique, actually requiring a
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   little bit of skill. Press the CROSS button within the highlighted
           areas on the Judgment Ring for successful attacks. Once you get used
           to the system more, feel free to try to time your attacks just right
           to succeed in more critical attacks in the smaller red area. If you
           miss though, you miss an attack completely.

Once you take out the Wind Shears, examine the body in the aisle for a
[_THERA LEAF_], then examine the body lying in the booth for a [_MANA LEAF_].
Head into the next car and proceed to the front, which will lead to more events
and a battle with Roger Bacon.

  NOTE     It's impossible to win this battle, so feel free to just wail away
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   at him, practicing your Judgment Ring until he uses Revelation to
           end the battle.

Watch some more events after the battle, then you'll be on the World Map. Feel
free to save out here if you like; you'll always be able to save your game on
the World Map. In any case, there's only one place to go: the Plains.
